name: WMUIReorderList
description: Drag-to-reorder list. Long-press a row to lift it, drag to a new position, and the reordered list is handed back to the page. The underlying library is pure JavaScript over Reanimated and Gesture Handler, so it also runs on web; upstream tests iOS and Android only, so keep a non-drag path for web users.

dataset.name: dataset
dataset.description: Rows to render, each with a label field. Example: [{id: 1, label: 'First'}, {id: 2, label: 'Second'}]

labelField.name: labelField
labelField.description: Row field shown as the row label. Default: label

itemHeight.name: itemHeight
itemHeight.description: Fixed row height in pixels. Default: 56

draggingRowColor.name: draggingRowColor
draggingRowColor.description: Row background while the row is lifted for dragging. Default: #EEF2FF

labelColor.name: labelColor
labelColor.description: Color of the row label text. Default: #111827

showSeparator.name: showSeparator
showSeparator.description: Whether to draw a hairline separator under each row. Default: true

enabled.name: enabled
enabled.description: Whether dragging is accepted. Set false for a read-only list. Default: true

onReorder.name: onReorder
onReorder.description: Fires after a drag completes, with the list in its new order plus the from and to indexes.

onItemPress.name: onItemPress
onItemPress.description: Fires with the row that was tapped rather than dragged.
